gate_results.name: rule_compliance
gate_results.rationale: This is a TRAIN-only privileged teacher. Geometry and simulator speed are intentionally used for demonstration feasibility and the teacher cannot be a submitted inference agent.

gate_results.name: mechanism_activation
gate_results.rationale: Across two TRAIN cells, the teacher changed gas 299 times and added braking 41 times while preserving the inherited pixel driver's steering. Both cells finished and no invalid action occurred.

gate_results.name: competitive_or_product_outcome
gate_results.rationale: Teacher and control each finished 2/2; paired laps were 23.38 versus 23.78 seconds and 21.86 versus 22.56 seconds. Teacher median 22.62 seconds improved 2.37% over control 23.17 seconds, below the preregistered 3% feasibility threshold. Teacher runs do not count as candidate completion rates.
